# Sarina's Art Blog

> > A comprehensive art education blog featuring video tutorials and practical guides for painting, drawing, and mixed media techniques across multiple mediums.

Sarina's Art Blog is a resource for artists of all skill levels, offering step-by-step video tutorials and detailed guides on painting techniques, color theory, and art materials. The blog covers watercolor, acrylic, colored pencils, and DIY craft projects with a focus on realistic figure and animal painting.

## Key Topics

- Video tutorials
- Watercolor painting
- Acrylic painting
- Colored pencils
- Pastels
- Color mixing
- Skin tones
- Drawing techniques
- Beginner guides
- Homemade clay recipes
- Realistic animal art
- Painting techniques
- Art habits and productivity
- Mixed media

## Video Painting Tutorials

- [How to Paint Skin Tones using Watercolours (video)](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2016/10/how-to-paint-skin-tones-using.html): Watercolor video tutorial on skin tone mixing and painting techniques
- [How to Paint a Realistic Dog Eye in Watercolour (video)](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2017/07/how-to-paint-realistic-dog-eye-in.html): Watercolor video tutorial for painting realistic dog eyes with color mixing
- [Learn how to mix flesh tones with acrylic paints (video)](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2015/06/learn-how-to-mix-flesh-tones-with.html): Acrylic painting video tutorial on mixing skin tones for portraits
- [Life Study - Acrylic Painting for Beginners video](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2016/08/life-study-acrylic-painting-for.html): Beginner acrylic painting video tutorial on life study and figure painting

## Drawing & Technique Guides

- [Top 7 Mistakes People Make When Using Coloured Pencils (video)](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2017/04/top-7-mistakes-people-make-when-using.html): Video guide on common colored pencil mistakes and techniques to avoid
- [Coloured Pencils with Pastels Video Tutorial](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2017/09/coloured-pencils-with-pastels-video.html): Video tutorial on mixed media technique combining colored pencils with pastels
- [How to Draw Better in 2 minutes! (video)](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2015/09/how-to-draw-better-in-2-minutes-video.html): Quick drawing improvement tips video tutorial for beginners

## Artist Development & Productivity

- [The 7 Habits of Highly Effective Artists (video)](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2017/04/the-7-habits-of-highly-effective.html): Video on artist productivity habits and creative development strategies
- [5 Tips to Be A Successful Artist (video)](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2016/01/5-tips-to-be-successful-artist-video.html): Video on artist success tips and career advice for beginners

## DIY Materials & Crafts

- [Best Homemade Clay Recipe: homemade polymer clay DIY?](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2018/01/best-homemade-clay-recipe-homemade.html): DIY homemade polymer and air-dry clay recipe tutorial by Sarina

## Art History & Discussion

- [Did you know famous abstract painter - Mondrian, painted the same tree for years?](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2015/06/did-you-know-famous-abstract-painter.html): Art history post on Mondrian's abstract evolution from figurative tree series
- [What do YOU think of Abstract Art?](https://sarinasartblog.blogspot.com/2015/06/what-do-you-think-of-abstract-art.html): Reader survey and discussion on abstract art and Jackson Pollock
